items.title: Visa’s CMO on How AI Agents Are Transforming Shopping
items.summary: Frank Cooper III, CMO of Visa, discusses how AI shopping agents are changing the way consumers discover and buy products, and what these technologies could mean for the shopping experience, in a conversation with Nat Ives at the WSJ Leadership Institute CMO Council Summit in New York.

items.title: How Visa is Marketing Through Frictionless Payment | WSJLI
items.summary: Visa CMO Frank Cooper III shares the strategies behind maintaining brand recognition as payment transactions become increasingly frictionless, and discusses the company’s use of sports partnerships, video games and content creators as the main vehicles of driving reach.

items.title: Visa Targets Secure AI Agent Payments Through Expanded Industry Partnership
items.summary: Visa Inc. (NYSE:V) announced on Tuesday that it expanded its Agentic Ready program to include merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), acquirers and commerce platforms, helping them prepare for transactions initiated by AI agents. The initiative, part of Visa Intelligent Commerce, launched with more than 140 participants, including Adyen, Antom, Billtrust, Checkout.com, Fiserv, Global Payments, PayPal and Stripe. items.title: Anthropic Is Going Public Into a Shaky Market. Here’s How Past Mega IPOs Fared in Similar Conditions.
items.summary: Visa and Facebook went public into chaos and rewarded patient owners, while Alibaba debuted in calm markets and stalled. Before Anthropic's Nasdaq debut, the real test may be which of these paths its unusual structure resembles.

items.title: PayPal Holdings (PYPL) Expands AI Driven Token Payments Acceptance
items.summary: PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS: PYPL) has partnered with Visa to expand support for AI-driven agentic token payments. The collaboration aims to let AI agents initiate tokenized Visa payments through PayPal's wallet and merchant acceptance network. The move aligns PayPal with sector wide efforts to build secure, programmable payment rails for autonomous digital transactions.
